$comment: Critical and serious axe violations each surface may still have, as node counts per rule, keyed <surface>/<mode>. A count above its entry fails the gate. Counts are the larger of CI (Linux) and Windows, whose fonts lay some controls out differently. Counts may only fall: check-baseline.mjs compares this file with the base branch, and `node check-baseline.mjs --update` lowers them from a run. owners names the 2.0 work package that removes each rule's violations.

owners.aria-required-children: P4 Excel semantics (A11Y-06): the grid has no rows or cells
owners.aria-required-parent: P4 Excel semantics (A11Y-06): grid headers have no row parent
owners.color-contrast: N11 Canvas and forced-colours fixes (A11Y-13): accents and tags under 4.5:1
owners.label-content-name-mismatch: P7 Suite chrome (profile and workspace buttons) and P8 Ribbon navigation (ribbon and status commands): the accessible name does not contain the visible label; new in axe 4.14, not in the audit
owners.role-img-alt: P4 Excel semantics (A11Y-06): the drawing layer is an unnamed image
owners.target-size: P8 Ribbon navigation and reflow (A11Y-18d): split-button carets under 24 px
